name: MedS-Bench
intro: MedS-Bench 是一个超越医学多项选择问答的综合临床语言模型基准。论文 v2 第 2.1 节与图 1 将 28 个现有数据集重构为约 30 万条样本、52 项任务和 11 个高层类别，但同版图 3 又写 39 个数据集；页面保留这一论文内部冲突，并另外标明固定发布快照与维护平台的计数漂移。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory; China Mobile Communications Group Co., Ltd.; China Mobile Communications Group Shanghai Co., Ltd.
build_method: 现有医学数据集整合, 指令问答重构, 手工任务定义, 技能分类, 防泄漏划分与成本抽样
metric: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, BLEU-1, ROUGE-1
language: 多语言（中文、英文、法文、日文、俄文、西班牙文）
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成, 抽取, 摘要, 事实验证
scale: 论文v2内部冲突：第2.1节/图1为28个来源数据集、52项任务、约30万样本；图3为39个数据集
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation, Extraction, Summarization, Fact Verification
build_method_en: Existing medical dataset integration, instruction-QA reformatting, hand-written task definitions, skill classification, leakage-safe splitting, and cost-aware sampling
intro_en: MedS-Bench is a comprehensive clinical-language-model benchmark beyond medical multiple-choice QA. Paper v2 Section 2.1 and Figure 1 reformat 28 source datasets into about 0.3 million samples, 52 tasks, and 11 high-level categories, but Figure 3 in the same version says 39 datasets. This page preserves that internal paper conflict and separately marks drift in fixed release snapshots and the maintained platform.

drawio_review_note: Source audit completed against arXiv:2408.12547v2, especially Section 2.1, Figure 1, Figure 3, Section 2.3, Section 4.4, Supplementary A.1-A.2, and the fixed official code snapshot https://github.com/MAGIC-AI4Med/MedS-Ins/tree/185cfc04a27023983e48b357a6f2fd525049b9af. Paper v2 has an unresolved internal count conflict: Section 2.1 and Figure 1 say 28 source datasets are reformatted into 52 tasks across 11 high-level categories and about 0.3 million samples, while Figure 3 in that same paper says 39 datasets. Each source is converted to an instruction-prompted QA record with a hand-written definition; tasks are manually grouped into eight categories that recall facts from model weights and three that retrieve facts from supplied context. Evaluation reuses an official train-test split where available and otherwise makes a random 9:1 split, holds test items and answers out of demonstrations, uses complete MCQA test sets, and cost-samples some other large test sets—often around 1,500, with dataset-specific counts in Supplementary A.2. The shot protocol also conflicts internally: Section 2.3 says MCQA is zero-shot and other clinical tasks are 3-shot, whereas Supplementary A.1 says all evaluations use 3-shot prompting. The paper does not reconcile those statements. The pinned evaluator sets NO_CONTEXT_P = 0.0 and ORI_INS = 1.0, so its default path is 3-shot with original definitions and does not automatically select the Section 2.3 MCQA exception. Accuracy covers closed decisions; Precision, Recall, and F1 cover multi-label outputs; BLEU-1 and ROUGE-1 are defaults for free-form generation. Fixed release counts are reported without normalization: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT/tree/bae9b49bb23ffcd5b1b64345f021d4d5b803b503 publishes 53 task JSON/JSONL files although the paper reports 52 tasks; the maintained repository README says 39 datasets, matching Figure 3 but not Section 2.1/Figure 1; and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Henrychur/MedS-Bench/tree/6945b14e0f408082aecb6a77a185b9ebdd5fb413 contains 32 task files after deleting Text_summarization. The official tutorial accepts either a submitted model or Hugging Face model link, or a result CSV, and the platform refreshes a dynamic leaderboard. Public access does not erase rights boundaries: the code LICENSE states CC BY-SA, the pinned README contains no license declaration, the HF benchmark card has no license field, and underlying source-dataset terms still apply. Formal publication evidence [site-a11u-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1645×825 (English) and 1645×825 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1643×823 and 1643×823. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
